company_name: Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company manufactures ultra-high purity components that are relevant for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd, through its DAJA brand, specializes in the design and manufacture of ultra-high purity (UHP) stainless steel tubing and flow control elements. Their products, including valves, fittings, and gaskets, are essential for maintaining the cleanliness and integrity of gas and chemical delivery systems in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: HP ball valve and butterfly valve
UHP Metal Face Seal fittings and gaskets

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is based in Taiwan and focuses on manufacturing high-quality UHP components for various industries.
